These five words appear to be the divine names used by other sects. Mani explains their significance by equating them with the appropriate Mani- chaean divinities. Mani was himself brought up in an Elchasaite commu- nity; and the Kephalaia makes a number of references to contemporary groups such as Baptists, Nazoreans, and Purified Ones (Catharioi). However, the exact identity of and relationship between these diverse Jewish-Chris- tian sects remains unclear. The First and the Second Life are characteristic Mandaean terms.
